name: hubstaff-qbo-hours-mvp
goal: Populate hours and client bill rate on existing QBO recurring sales receipts using one Service item per VA. Do not create invoices. Do not write Hubstaff/VA pay rates. Do not merge live customers from this workflow.

qbo_model.va: QBO Product/Service, type Service (not a customer-per-VA)
qbo_model.standard_rate: Optional client bill rate on the Service item. Not Hubstaff pay / HH PH / net pay.
qbo_model.revenue_account: Each VA Service needs a Chart of Accounts revenue account (Matt/Alexander).
qbo_model.sales_receipt: VA Service lines populate the sales receipt individually or as a list per customer. VA name, rate, and hours on the line.
qbo_model.customer: One QBO customer per real client. Individual customers are not used to track VA work.
qbo_model.customer_merge: Human-only, later, if the model works. Preserves previous sales receipts on the merged customer. Never from this workflow. Phantom first.

mapping_file.description: Rows with status=confirmed. Use mapping/from-tracker.csv (VA-level) joined to Hubstaff project IDs; mapping/BLANK.csv is project-level. VA maps to qbo_item_id (Service).

tracker.title: HELPER HEROES CLIENT LIST & TRACKER
tracker.description: Source of truth for VA hours and billing adjustments. Read-only. Do not edit the live Sheet from this workflow.

fail_closed: pay_rate present on a QBO write
HH PH or net pay present on a QBO write

steps.name: Pull prior-week VA hours from Hubstaff

hubstaff.why: Weekly aggregates for billing, not 10-minute activity blocks

alternates.use: audit only, too granular for MVP hours

never: create/update/delete Hubstaff clients, projects, members, rates, or hours
live Hubstaff writes of any kind

steps.name: Map hours to Hubstaff project / member / client
Translate to QBO customer + VA Service line
steps.dba_vs_legal: Tracker Client Name is DBA; Legal Business Name is legal. QBO customer is the real client (legal). Hubstaff project names are often DBA/location. The VA is a Service item on that customer, not its own customer.
never: create a QBO customer per VA

steps.name: Update VA Service lines on phantom QBO recurring sales receipt

qbo.object: RecurringTransaction / Sales Receipt (template or next instance)
qbo.write: Qty/hours and optional client bill rate on the VA Service line
qbo.cadence: Update before Monday confirm; ACH auto-sends Tuesday
qbo.hours_field: Qty/hours on the sales-receipt line for that VA Service
qbo.rate: Standard client bill rate on the Service, or line override. Not Hubstaff pay.

never: write pay_rate / VA Hourly Rate to HH PH / VAs Hourly Net Pay to QBO

steps.name: Reconcile vs Celdy tracker expected/actual/weekly hours (not a mystery Excel) before any live client

hours_fields.actual_hours: Actual Hours Worked (currently contracted weekly hours on Client List)
hours_fields.weekly_hours_col: Rolling weekly column, currently HH061 (Aug 24-30). Won/Leads tabs still show stale HH053 (June 29- July 5).

compare: Hubstaff prior-week hours vs tracker weekly column for that week
proposed QBO hours vs tracker expected/actual/weekly
unmapped Hubstaff projects vs unmatched tracker rows
steps.success_means: Proposed phantom QBO hours match what Matt would type from this tracker, not from a private mystery Excel.

pilot_after_phantom.customer_merge: Only Matt/Alexander, and only after phantom proves the Service model

qbo_cadence.quote: There is nothing to submit, we are only updating information that I will confirm on Monday and will auto-sent on Tuesday.
qbo_cadence.hours_field_name: Qty on the sales-receipt line for the VA Service item
qbo_cadence.hours_field_note: Alexander: rate and hours live on the VA Service line of the sales receipt. VA name is the Service name. Do not invent a custom field.
qbo_cadence.hours_source_of_truth: Celdy tracker Client List expected/actual/weekly hours (HH0xx), not a mystery Excel and not raw Hubstaff alone.
